payload.title: Ship editorial and publishing release with review and rollback
payload.goal: Deliver one excellent piece and a repeatable content pipeline rather than only a canary.
payload.owner_role: Windows combined release parent / admitted WHB lane
implementation_steps: Review exact publisher/source/asset/workflow manifest independently, preserving startup regression evidence and identified account scope.

Hand reviewed candidate and operator release to the existing release parent for qualified deployment; verify one public X post and two next candidates under the new pipeline. Optional platforms remain independent effects.
Record kill/pause/cancel versus already-public correction semantics, prior source/queue snapshot and release receipt. Reverting code alone must not imply public post deletion.
tests: Source/hash reviewed is the source/hash used by the job and public piece.
One X public post, provider receipt and measurement baseline link correctly; next candidates are separately sourced/reviewable.
Pause prevents new enqueue; rollback retains existing post receipts and defines how any scheduled item is canceled only through allowed route.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: Substantive editorial operation has a useful public piece, usable next pipeline and recovery.
Release does not wait for SH runtime completion or all three historical channels.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
